$comment: Frozen public fixture for the v0.1.0 Developer Preview smoke task. Every field is the exact value the quickstart tells an operator to enter, so a check can compare what the console sends against this file rather than against prose. It contains no credential, no identifier from any installation, and nothing host-specific. Changing a value here changes what the release claims to have proved.

task.name: OSS-B0 v0.1.0 deterministic smoke
task.description: Create exactly one new file at the repository root, named agentos-smoke.txt, whose entire contents are the UTF-8 bytes `OSS-B0 v0.1.0 smoke` followed by a single newline. Change nothing else: no other file may be added, modified, renamed or deleted, and no dependency may be installed. Commit that one file with the commit subject `oss-b0: add deterministic smoke marker` and nothing after it on the subject line. Do not open a pull request.

expected.parent: the disposable repository's recorded seed commit
expected.delivery: push reported as successful, with no pull request opened
failureModes: the run hits the 15-minute wall clock or the 5-minute stall timeout
the pushed tree differs from the expected tree by anything other than agentos-smoke.txt
the file bytes or the commit subject do not match exactly
delivery reports a pull request URL
